subject: prd/feature-draft
statement: The system shall treat a feature draft as ready only when the links among its requirements and tech-spec decisions form a consistent graph — no link to a nonexistent requirement, no broken supersession, and no cycle.
rationale: Compilability, carried over from the planning gate (brainstorm:feature-draft#D-20)
fit_criterion: Fixtures with a decision serving a nonexistent requirement, a broken supersession, and a dependency cycle are each refused naming the inconsistency.
